column3: “One he has chosen” is rendered “whom alone God has chosen,” and “a youth and weak” as “young and inexperienced.” NASB adds “still.”
“According to all my power” is rendered “with all my ability”; NASB supplies “the things of.” The names of several stones are uncertain.
“Again” is rendered “moreover,” and “because I delight” as “in my delight.” “The house of the holiness” is rendered “the holy temple.”
“Houses” is rendered “buildings.”
“To fill his hand” is rendered “to consecrate himself,” and “making a contribution” as “willing.”
“Made a contribution” is rendered “offered willingly,” and “leaders” as “rulers” and “overseers.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“The one who was found with him stones” is rendered “whoever possessed precious stones,” and “on the hand of” as “in care of.”
“Made a contribution” is rendered “offered so willingly,” and “complete heart” as “whole heart.”
“From antiquity until perpetuity” is rendered “forever and ever.”
“The eminence” is rendered “the victory.”
NASB supplies “it lies.”
“The name of your splendor” is rendered “Your glorious name.”
“Retain strength” is rendered “be able,” and “make a contribution like this” as “offer as generously as this.”
“Resident aliens” is rendered “tenants”; NASB supplies “were.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“And I know” is rendered “Since I know,” and “made a contribution” as “willingly offered.”
“Keep” is rendered “preserve,” and “the inclination of the thoughts of the heart” as “the intentions of the heart.”
“Complete heart” is rendered “perfect heart.”
“Bowed down” is rendered “did homage.”
“Drink offerings” is rendered “libations.”
“To Yahweh to ruler” is rendered “as ruler for the LORD.”
“Listened to him” is rendered “obeyed him.”
“Gave a hand under” is rendered “pledged allegiance to.”
“Put” is rendered “bestowed.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“The days” is rendered “the period.”
“Good old age” is rendered “a ripe old age.”
“Matters” is rendered “acts,” and “words” as “chronicles.”
“Times” is rendered “circumstances.”
